[NCBK.7.2] **One setter, two persistence callbacks, one shared `user`** —
`ds_engine_cache_callbacks(engine, abi_version, set_cb, delete_cb, user)`. The
same external-store handle backs both, so they share context. The setter keeps
the name `ds_engine_cache_callbacks` (no `set_` prefix): the two persistence ops
are one durability surface, not independent registrations.

The caller passes the `DS_CACHE_CB_ABI_VERSION` it compiled against, which is
`3` in this edition. A mismatch is refused with `DS_ERR_BACKEND_ABI_VERSION`
and registers nothing, so a caller built against a header with other callback
signatures is never invoked with an argument it does not expect ([NCBK.7.4]).
The value is append-only ([STYL.2.8.7]): a change to either callback's
signature takes the next number, and no number is reissued.
